narration.text: Suppose one RUN adds a hundred-megabyte file: its payload enters an immutable image layer, which later steps cannot rewrite.
A later RUN hides the file with a whiteout, but the earlier layer still holds its bytes.
Create and delete that new file within the same RUN, and its payload never enters the resulting image diff.
